description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

description.zh:
刷新/预热任务类型，取值：
- **file**（默认值）：文件刷新。
- **preload**：文件预热。
- **directory**：目录刷新。
- **ignoreParams**：去参数刷新。
description.en:
The type of the refresh or prefetch task. Valid values:
- **file** (default): file refresh.
- **preload**: file prefetch.
- **directory**: directory refresh.
- **ignoreParams**: parameter-ignored refresh.
The name of the upload task.

description.zh:
OSS存储刷新或者预热文件的URL。Url 参数接受两种格式的 URL：

- 中转 URL（推荐），通过 ESA 控制台或 SDK 的文件传输功能自动生成。

- OSS pre-signed HTTPS URL，需将文件上传至有权限的 OSS Bucket 后生成。isFileTransferUrl 字段标识是否使用中转 URL 模式。
description.en:
The URL of the refresh or prefetch file stored in OSS. The Url parameter accepts URLs in two formats:

- Transit URL (recommended): automatically generated through the file transfer feature of the ESA console or SDK.

- OSS pre-signed HTTPS URL: generated after you upload the file to an authorized OSS bucket. The isFileTransferUrl field specifies whether to use the transit URL mode.

title.zh: 上传刷新或者预热文件
title.en: Upload a refresh or prefetch file

descriptions.en:
> 
> - The maximum file size is 10 MB.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa upload-file --site-id 1234567890000 --url https://XXXXXX.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/_prefix_account_uid_hash --type file --upload-task-name purge_task_2024_11_11 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa UploadFile --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234567890000 --Type file --UploadTaskName purge_task_2024_11_11 --Url 'https://XXXXXX.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/_prefix_account_uid_hash'
